storage.googleapis.com.title: California Forest Observatory
storage.googleapis.com.summary: The Forest Observatory is a data-driven forest monitoring system that maps the drivers of wildfire behavior across the state with a focus on vegetation fuels. Data are available for non-commercial use under the Forest Observatory [terms of use](https://forestobservatory.com/legal.html).

storage.googleapis.com.title: Extremadura SDI (CICTEX)
storage.googleapis.com.summary: Portolan catalog with a selection of geospatial data from the Regional Government of Extremadura (CICTEX), originally distributed via the SITEX Download Centre (sitex.juntaex.es/SITEX/centrodescargas). Data has been reprojected to EPSG:4326 and converted to cloud-native formats (GeoParquet, PMTiles); this is not the official distribution. Licensed CC-BY 4.0 CICTEX, Junta de Extremadura. This catalog is a publishing demo using Portolan and is not an official data source.

storage.googleapis.com.title: Google Earth Engine
storage.googleapis.com.summary: List of all rasters and vectors present in the [Google Earth Engine Catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/).

coclico.blob.core.windows.net.title: CoCliCo STAC Catalog
coclico.blob.core.windows.net.summary: The funded CoCliCo project enhances coastal risk management by offering an open-source platform for assessing sea-level rise impacts. It visualizes, analyzes, and contextualizes coastal risks, combining geospatial data with decision tools, uniting experts in adaptation and risk communication.

fiboa.org.title: fiboa Field Boundaries
fiboa.org.summary:
The Field Boundaries for Agriculture (fiboa) project is focused on making field boundary data openly available in a unified format on a global scale.
This STAC catalog provides a collection of field boundary data from various sources, but all converted to be fiboa compliant.

rawcdn.githack.com.title: IDE Facultad de Ciencia y Tecnología UADER
rawcdn.githack.com.summary: Lista de raster y vectores presentes en la IDE de la Facultad de Ciencia y Tecnología - UADER

datacloud.icgc.cat.title: Monthly Mosaic of Sentinel 2 Images for Catalonia
datacloud.icgc.cat.summary: Monthly mosaics of sentinel-2 images over Catalonia, choosing lowest cloud coverage for each timespan. Indexes several collections of different Cloud Optimized Geotiffs: RGB de 8/16 bits, IRC  8/16 bits.

nz-elevation.s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.title: New Zealand Elevation
nz-elevation.s3.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.summary: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand makes New Zealand's publicly owned elevation archive freely available to use under an open licence. This public S3 bucket has been made available to enable bulk access and cloud-based data processing.

portal.opentopography.org.title: OpenTopography Raster DEM Data Catalog
portal.opentopography.org.summary: A catalog of OpenTopography hosted raster topography (digital elevation model) datasets.

radiantearth.blob.core.windows.net.title: RapidAI4EO
radiantearth.blob.core.windows.net.summary: RapidAI4EO corpus of spatiotemporal imagery and LULC labels for machine learning training.

meeo-s5p.s3.amazonaws.com.title: Sentinel 5P Level 2 on AWS
meeo-s5p.s3.amazonaws.com.summary: Observations from the Sentinel-5 Precursor (Sentinel-5P) satellite of the European Commission’s Copernicus Earth Observation Programme. Hosted on AWS.

api.fgdc.gov.title: 🇺🇸 United States | Address Data Theme
api.fgdc.gov.summary: The Address Theme consists of the data elements, attributes, and metadata that specify a fixed geographic location by reference to a thoroughfare or landmark, or specify a point of postal delivery, or both.

api.fgdc.gov.title: 🇺🇸 United States | Alabama Geoportal Resources
api.fgdc.gov.summary: Alabama's Open Data Portal (ODP) is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. Inside Alabama's ODP, you can browse, search, preview, and download a variety of Alabama and national geospatial data.

api.fgdc.gov.title: 🇺🇸 United States | Alaska Geospatial Resources
api.fgdc.gov.summary: Alaska’s GeoPortal is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. The OGC Compliant API allows you to browse, search, preview, and download a variety of state and national geospatial data.

api.fgdc.gov.title: 🇺🇸 United States | Cadastre Data Theme
api.fgdc.gov.summary: Cadastre information from the U.S. Past, current, and future rights and interests in real property including the spatial information necessary to describe geographic extents.

api.fgdc.gov.title: 🇺🇸 United States | California Geospatial Data
api.fgdc.gov.summary: California’s GeoPortal is the states platform for exploring and downloading open data, discovering and building apps, and engaging the public through geospatial data. The OGC Compliant API allows you to browse, search, preview, and download a variety of state and national geospatial data.

s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com.title: USGS 3DEP LiDAR Point Clouds
s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com.summary: LiDAR 3DEP elevation data over the conterminous United States, Hawaii, and the U.S. territories, acquired over an 8-year period. Hosted on AWS.
